import boto3
import os
from typing import List, Dict

def select_voice(language_code: str = "en-US") -> List[Dict]:
    polly_client = boto3.client(
        "polly",
        region_name=os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1"),
        aws_access_key_id=os.environ.get("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
        aws_secret_access_key=os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
    )
    response = polly_client.describe_voices(LanguageCode=language_code)
    return response["Voices"]

import boto3
import os

def save_audio(audio_bytes: bytes, bucket_name: str, key: str):
    s3_client = boto3.client(
        "s3",
        region_name=os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1"),
        aws_access_key_id=os.environ.get("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
        aws_secret_access_key=os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
    )
    s3_client.put_object(Bucket=bucket_name, Key=key, Body=audio_bytes)

import boto3
import os

def script_translate(text: str, source_language: str, target_language: str) -> str:
    translate_client = boto3.client(
        "translate",
        region_name=os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1"),
        aws_access_key_id=os.environ.get("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
        aws_secret_access_key=os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
    )
    response = translate_client.translate_text(
        Text=text,
        SourceLanguageCode=source_language,
        TargetLanguageCode=target_language
    )
    return response["TranslatedText"]

import boto3
import os
from typing import List, Dict

def script_safety(text: str) -> List[Dict]:
    comprehend_client = boto3.client(
        "comprehend",
        region_name=os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1"),
        aws_access_key_id=os.environ.get("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
        aws_secret_access_key=os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
    )
    # Detects personally identifiable information (PII) entities
    response = comprehend_client.detect_pii_entities(Text=text, LanguageCode="en")
    return response["Entities"]

import boto3
import os
import json

def script_embedding(text: str) -> list:
    bedrock_runtime_client = boto3.client(
        "bedrock-runtime",
        region_name=os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1"),
        aws_access_key_id=os.environ.get("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
        aws_secret_access_key=os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
    )
    model_id = "amazon.titan-embed-text-v1"
    body = json.dumps({"inputText": text})
    response = bedrock_runtime_client.invoke_model(
        body=body, modelId=model_id, accept="application/json", contentType="application/json"
    )
    response_body = json.loads(response.get("body").read())
    return response_body.get("embedding")
